oneShuttle.text: No [1] between Dyckman St, Upper Manhattan and Van Cortlandt Park-242 St, Bronx
oneShuttle.description:
[1] trains run between Dyckman St and South Ferry, every 8 minutes (days/evenings).

[shuttle bus icon] Free shuttle buses run between Van Cortlandt Park-242 St and Dyckman St.
Transfer between [1] and [shuttle bus icon] buses at Dyckman St [accessibility icon] or between [A] and [shuttle bus icon] buses at Inwood-207 St [accessibility icon].
See a map of this service change.

Lefferts Blvd [A] trains are rerouted to Howard Beach-JFK Airport
aBranch.description:
[A] trains run between Inwood-207 St and Howard Beach-JFK Airport or Far Rockaway-Mott Av.

[shuttle bus icon] Free shuttle buses make stops between Rockaway Blvd and Ozone Park-Lefferts Blvd, stopping at 104 St and 111 St.
Transfer between [A] and [shuttle bus icon] at Rockaway Blvd.
See a map of this service change.

aSkip.text: In Manhattan, uptown [A] local skips 72 St, 81 St-Museum of Natural History, 86 St, 96 St, 103 St, Cathedral Pkwy-110 St and 116 St
aSkip.description:
For service to these stations, take the [A] to 125 St and transfer to a downtown [A] or [D].

For service from these stations, take the [A] or [D] to 59 St-Columbus Circle and transfer to an uptown [A].

Schedule reminder: [A] skips these stations days and evenings.

Note: Downtown [D] runs local from 125 St to 59 St-Columbus Circle during this time.

dLocal.text: In Manhattan, downtown [D] runs local from 125 St to 59 St-Columbus Circle

jSuspended.text: No [J] between Myrtle Av and Broad St
jSuspended.description:
[J] runs between Jamaica Center-York College and Myrtle Av, the last stop.

[shuttle bus icon] Free T432 shuttle buses run between Myrtle Av and Delancey St-Essex St.

See a map of this service change.
